name: core_workflow_agent
description: Delegate core record work to morgan_stanley_simulated's workflow sub-agent using a natural-language request. Prefer this over raw update tools when the user supplies a business handle. It resolves a unique business handle or exact non-lifecycle attribute inside the tool, applies one scoped update, returns the before/after record, and rejects missing, ambiguous, or out-of-lifecycle values. Use only when the target appears in this owned table/handle scope: account_tiering_standard[name], activity_logging_standards[name], case_management_sla[name], compliance_review_checklist[name], cpq_discount_policy[name], data_quality_rules[name], deal_desk_charter[name], finance_approval_thresholds[name], forecast_methodology[name], lead_management_sop[name], lead_scoring_policy[name], opportunity_stage_gates[name], order_activation_runbook[name], renewal_playbook[name], territory[name]. Request grammar: in table <table>, find <business_field> "<value>" and either set <field> to "<value>" or set <field> to the next declared lifecycle stage.

request.description: Natural-language workflow request containing a unique business handle or exact readable attribute and requested outcome
